g.text: Use nonpolar X7R capacitors; verify capacitance under DC bias.

g.desc: Use nonpolar X7R capacitors; verify capacitance under DC bias.

g.text: Power-on: hold reset low, enable +3V3_EPD, initialize, then update. Quiesce SPI and sleep the panel before power-off.

g.desc: Power-on: hold reset low, enable +3V3_EPD, initialize, then update. Quiesce SPI and sleep the panel before power-off.

g.text: U301 isolates MCU outputs when the panel supply is off (Ioff-rated). BUSY is a pulled-down input.

g.desc: U301 isolates MCU outputs when the panel supply is off (Ioff-rated). BUSY is a pulled-down input.

g.text: FPC pins 1 and 4 are NC per the raw-panel document.

g.desc: FPC pins 1 and 4 are NC per the raw-panel document.

g.text: Pin 5 is VSH2. VDD on pin 18 is local 1.8 V, not the 3.3 V input.

g.desc: Pin 5 is VSH2. VDD on pin 18 is local 1.8 V, not the 3.3 V input.

g.text: Release gates: exact panel, FPC orientation, inductor saturation,

g.desc: Release gates: exact panel, FPC orientation, inductor saturation,

g.text: J301 intentionally has no PCB footprint pending the mating audit.

g.desc: J301 intentionally has no PCB footprint pending the mating audit.

g.text: Prototype electrical capture. Physical FPC mating and panel revision must be verified before layout.

g.desc: Prototype electrical capture. Physical FPC mating and panel revision must be verified before layout.
